description: Create a new Monitor in OneUptime. Returns the created Monitor object with its ID. Use this to add new Monitors to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

cephClusters.description: Ceph clusters this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

currentMonitorStatusId.description: Whats the current status ID of this monitor?

databaseServers.description: Databases this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

dependsOnMonitors.description: Parent monitors this monitor depends on. When a parent is offline (or in one of the configured suppression statuses), alerts and incidents from this monitor are suppressed at creation time — the monitor keeps evaluating and its status timeline still updates.

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of very long text content that might be stored in this field. It can contain a lot of information, such as detailed descriptions, comments, or any other lengthy text data that needs to be stored in the database.

disableActiveMonitoring.description: Disable active monitoring for this resource?

dockerHosts.description: Docker hosts this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

dockerSwarmClusters.description: Docker Swarm clusters this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

hosts.description: Hosts this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

incomingMonitorRequest.description: Incoming Monitor Request for Incoming Request Monitor.

incomingRequestMonitorHeartbeatCheckedAt.description: This field is for Incoming Request monitor only. When was the last time we checked the heartbeat?

iotFleets.description: IoT fleets this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

isArchived.description: Archived monitors are hidden from monitor lists and status pages, are not checked, and open no incidents or alerts. Unarchiving resumes monitoring.

kubernetesClusters.description: Kubernetes clusters this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

labels.description: Relation to Labels Array where this object is categorized in.

minimumProbeAgreement.description: Minimum number of probes that must agree on a status before the monitor status changes. If null, all enabled and connected probes must agree.

monitorSteps.description: What would you like to monitor and what is the criteria?

monitorTemplateId.description: ID of the Monitor Template this monitor was created from. Null for monitors not created from a template.

monitorType.description: What is the type of this monitor? Website? API? etc.

monitoringInterval.description: How often would you like OneUptime to monitor this resource? A 5-field cron expression, not a label: "*/5 * * * *" is every five minutes.

name.description: Any friendly name for this monitor.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

proxmoxClusters.description: Proxmox clusters this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

serverMonitorRequestReceivedAt.description: This field is for Server Monitor only. When was the last time we received a request?

serverMonitorResponse.description: Server Monitor Response for Server Monitor.

services.description: Services this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them, so OneUptime AI can investigate and fix them there.

storageArrays.description: Storage arrays this monitor watches. Incidents and alerts it creates are linked to them.

suppressAlertsWhenParentMonitorStatuses.description: Parent monitor statuses that suppress this monitor's alerts and incidents. When empty, statuses flagged as offline suppress (the default). Only used when Depends On Monitors is set.

telemetryMonitorLastMonitorAt.description: This field is for Telemetry Monitor only. When was the last time we monitored?

telemetryMonitorNextMonitorAt.description: This field is for Telemetry Monitor only. When is the next time we should monitor?
